name: Dance Me to the End of the World
source:
Explicit scenes and heavy subject matter are present in this work. Additional content warnings can be found in the title screen menu.

A story about people who wouldn’t call themselves remarkable.

You are Keo. Your father’s kicked you out of the house. It’s your first year of university. The monsoon season’s on its tail and coming to an end. You’ve moved in with your best friend Mai. You’ve just gotten a job at a bar run by her friend, Memo. And that’s all you need to know.

TextRPG-styled visual novel. 45k words. About 2-3 hours reading time. Poorly written, verbose, self-indulgent, uneventful, and overall boring to read.

“The first act was hard to stomach. I think the author probably didn’t have a lot of experience in the genre, and it showed through. I liked the second act, though.” - Keo

“Why did they do that…? Everything could have been so nice if the writer didn’t do that…” - Mai

“The plot doesn’t really go anywhere. Plus it could have done with more erotic scenes. Why even tell this story if you’re going to hold out like that?” - Rue

“...I’ll leave it to the others to give their thoughts.” - Memo

“Author’s note? Oh, no, I don’t have the time… I originally wasn’t going to publish this, since I found most of the VN weak and I didn’t end up finishing it to the degree that I wanted to (save/load only saves your current scene and not your position, the art is basically a placeholder, didn’t have time to make any of the custom songs or CGs, and there were supposed to be sprites / Keo’s little icon in the corner would change based on mood…), but I’m proud of myself for getting the writing done at least and I poured quite a lot into some scenes, so I’ll let myself put something into the world for once as a treat. I do hope you enjoy!” - Robin

[from [url=https://midnightsrobin.itch.io/dance-me-to-the-end-of-the-world]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
本作包含露骨场景与沉重题材内容，详细内容警告可在标题画面菜单中查阅。

这是一个关于一群绝不会自称“不凡之人”的故事。

你是凯奥。父亲把你赶出了家门。眼下是你上大学的第一年，雨季已步入尾声、行将结束。你搬去与挚友小舞同住，刚在她朋友梅莫经营的酒吧里谋到了一份差事。你需要提前了解的，就只有这么多。

文字RPG风格的视觉小说，全篇约4.5万字，阅读时长约2—3小时。文笔拙劣、啰嗦冗长、自嗨过度、平淡无奇，整体读起来颇为乏味。

“第一幕实在令人难以下咽。我觉得作者大概没什么这类题材的创作经验，短板暴露无遗。不过第二幕我还挺喜欢的。”——凯奥

“作者为什么要那么写啊……？要是没写那一段的话，明明一切都会那么美好的……”——小舞

“剧情根本没往任何方向推进嘛。而且明明可以多塞点色情戏的。要是打算这么藏着掖着，干脆一开始就别讲这个故事啊？”——露

“……感想就留给其他人去说吧。”——梅莫

“作者的话？哦，算了吧，我赶时间呢……我原本压根没打算公开这部作品，因为我觉得整部视觉小说大半都挺薄弱的，最终也没能打磨到自己理想中的完成度（存档/读档只记录当前场景而不记录具体行位置、美术素材基本都是占位图、没时间制作原创配乐与CG、本来还打算画角色立绘，让角落里凯奥的小头像随心情变化……）；但至少我把剧本写完了，对此我还是挺为自己骄傲的，而且有几场戏确实倾注了我不少心血，所以就当犒劳自己一回，把作品发出来见见世面吧。真心希望你能喜欢！”——罗宾

[摘自[url=https://midnightsrobin.itch.io/dance-me-to-the-end-of-the-world]itch.io[/url]]
